G4(a) reachability test, scripts/openmetal.py. Criterion: a metal is CH4-exposed when some point within rmax of the metal nucleus gives a CH4 united atom clearance >= 1.865 A (half UFF sigma) from every framework atom vdW surface -- reachability, not ligand count, because G4 asks about the guest-site interaction class. THRESHOLD rmax is replicate-chosen; all three settings evaluated: exposed metals at rmax 4.0/4.5/5.0 = 4/4/4 of 4 total metals; smallest rmax at which any metal is reachable = 4.0 A. SENSITIVITY: the class-(a) assignment is unchanged at every rmax tested, so the identity of the Claim does not depend on the threshold. Class (a) is CLAIMABLE for methane under Rev 18 with no admissibility consequence; the single obligation is the stated caveat, which appears wherever this structure appears in the Claim.
